phone.changelog: v2.11.0: Readable turn-by-turn watch navigation. Enable Device > Watch navigation and allow notification access, start a Google Maps route on the phone, then open Apps > Navigation on the watch. Large directions and next-turn distance replace the need to read phone screenshots. Update both apps; trip details depend on Maps notifications.

watch.changelog: v2.11.0: New Apps > Navigation shows large Google Maps directions, next-turn distance, available maneuver arrows and trip details. Enable Watch navigation in the updated phone app and allow notification access. Directions clear when disconnected or updates expire. Phone screen sharing remains optional; no capture prompt is needed for directions.
